title: A rectangle formatted by an object style
concept: A rectangle with no fill or stroke of its own applies an object style; the style, based on [None], supplies a 40 % red fill and a 2 pt black stroke.

annotations.note: [None] is InDesign's built-in object style: no fill, no stroke. Its Self uses the reserved $ID/ namespace.
The Panel style sets the fill (Color/Red at FillTint 40) and a 2 pt black stroke. EnableFill and EnableStroke switch those categories of the style on.
Panel names its parent in a typed BasedOn child, as InDesign writes it. Anything Panel leaves unset comes from [None].
